blurb: Ocean Therapy Charters offers scuba diving charters and PADI and SSI scuba certification courses. Guests can take private or group scuba lessons, participate in introductory programs for kids, or book private boat charters for snorkeling and scuba diving. The company emphasizes safety, professional instruction, and personalized experiences.
